name: @fyeeme/pi-hooks
description: Claude Code-compatible hooks runner for pi. Reads hooks config (priority: ~/.pi/agent/hook.json, then project .pi/hook.json) and maps SessionStart, PreToolUse, and Stop events to pi lifecycle events.
